title: Bachelor Point
synopsis: A hilarious and heartfelt comedy-drama following a group of bachelors living together in a mess apartment in Dhaka. Through their everyday struggles—love, ambition, friendship, and failure—the show captures the raw and relatable reality of young men navigating life in urban Bangladesh.
logline: Six bachelors. One apartment. Infinite chaos.
concept: The idea stemmed from the relatable memories of bachelor life in Dhaka.
directorNote: Bachelor Point is not just a comedy. It's a love letter to every young man who ever ate cold rice alone and called it dinner.
inspiration: Inspired by personal experiences of bachelor life in Dhaka.
challenges: Coordinating with a large recurring cast across multiple seasons while maintaining the natural chemistry.
directorPerspective: This show taught me that simplicity is the highest form of complexity.

successStats.milestone: Most popular comedy series in Bangladesh
successStats.culturalImpact: Spawned countless memes, catchphrases ('Pasha Bhai', 'Khabia'), and fan communities.

title: Oshomoy
synopsis: A departure from his usual comedy, Oshomoy explores contemporary societal issues, blending drama, romance, and tragedy. It delves into the harsh realities of modern life, the show-off culture, and the consequences of untimely decisions.
logline: A poignant reflection on contemporary societal issues and tragedy.
concept: To showcase a different dimension of storytelling, breaking away from the pure comedy genre.
directorNote: Oshomoy was a challenge to myself to tell a story that makes people think deeply about the society we live in.
inspiration: The changing dynamics of modern society and unexpected turns in human lives.
challenges: Shifting audience expectations from pure comedy to serious drama.
directorPerspective: I wanted to prove that a storyteller is not bound by a single genre.

successStats.milestone: A critically acclaimed shift in genre for the director
successStats.culturalImpact: Praised for its realistic portrayal of society.

title: Hotel Relax
synopsis: When a diverse group of quirky characters ends up at the mysterious 'Hotel Relax', chaos ensues. A blend of comedy, suspense, and unexpected situations in a single location.
logline: Checking in is easy, relaxing is impossible.
concept: A situational comedy-thriller taking place in a single primary location.
directorNote: I wanted to create an ensemble piece where the location itself feels like a character.
inspiration: Classic locked-room mysteries blended with signature situational comedy.
challenges: Managing an ensemble cast in a confined space.
directorPerspective: The fun is in seeing how completely different personalities clash.

successStats.milestone: One of the most successful series on the Binge platform

title: Female 3
synopsis: The highly anticipated third installment of the 'Female' comedy series, bringing back the fan-favorite characters for another round of hilarious local neighborhood conflicts and rivalry.
concept: To expand on the immensely popular 'Female' franchise with higher stakes and bigger laughs.
directorNote: It's always a joy returning to these characters. The audience's love for them makes the hard work worth it.
inspiration: Neighborhood politics and comedic rivalries.
challenges: Matching the sky-high expectations set by the previous two installments.

successStats.milestone: Shattered previous viewership records for single dramas

title: Bachelor's Qurbani
synopsis: A special spin-off from the Bachelor Point universe, this episode focuses on the chaotic and hilarious events that unfold when the bachelors attempt to purchase and manage a sacrificial animal for Eid-ul-Adha.
logline: Eid preparations have never been this chaotic.
concept: A festive special bringing the beloved characters into an Eid-ul-Adha scenario.
directorNote: We wanted to capture the true, messy, and hilarious essence of Qurbani Eid for bachelors.
inspiration: The cultural nuances and comedic situations of buying a Qurbani cow in Dhaka.
challenges: Filming with animals and managing large crowds during the festive season.

successStats.viewership: Record breaking concurrent viewership during premiere
successStats.milestone: One of the most watched Eid specials

title: ME & U
synopsis: A romantic comedy-drama that explores the nuances of modern relationships, misunderstandings, and the hilarious situations that arise when two contrasting personalities collide.
logline: Opposites attract, but first, they fight.
concept: A fresh take on the romantic comedy genre, driven by strong dialogue and chemistry.
directorNote: Romance doesn't always have to be overly sweet; sometimes the best love stories are full of arguments.
inspiration: The reality of modern urban relationships.
challenges: Balancing the comedy with genuine emotional moments.

title: X Girlfriend
synopsis: A highly acclaimed romantic drama that explores the complexities of past relationships, heartbreak, and the difficulty of moving on when your past confronts your present.
logline: Some pasts are hard to escape.
concept: To depict the realistic and often messy aftermath of a breakup.
directorNote: I wanted to portray the raw emotions of heartbreak without sugarcoating the pain.
inspiration: Real-life stories of modern breakups and emotional lingering.
challenges: Extracting nuanced, vulnerable performances from the lead cast.

successStats.milestone: Established the director's prowess in romantic dramas

title: X Boyfriend
synopsis: Released as a Valentine's Day special, this companion piece to X Girlfriend flips the perspective to explore love, regret, and closure from the other side of a failed relationship.
logline: Moving on is never as simple as it seems.
concept: A thematic continuation exploring the male perspective on past relationships.
directorNote: Love is rarely a one-sided story.
inspiration: The dual nature of every relationship's end.
challenges: Creating a distinct emotional tone while remaining thematically linked to its predecessor.

successStats.viewership: Highly viewed during the Valentine's period

title: Hello Baby
synopsis: A hilarious and sweet story about the complications and humorous situations a young couple faces when navigating marriage and societal expectations regarding having a child.
logline: The ultimate pressure test for a young couple.
concept: To satirize the immense societal pressure placed on newly married couples in Bangladesh.
directorNote: Comedy is the best tool to address societal pressures without sounding preachy.
inspiration: The common questions faced by every married couple in South Asia.
challenges: Balancing the comedic timing with the genuine anxiety of the characters.

successStats.viewership: Millions of views, viral on social media

title: Doi
synopsis: A Valentine's Day special that revolves around a simple pot of yogurt (Doi) and the cascading, hilarious misunderstandings it creates among a group of people.
logline: A single pot of sweet yogurt causes a very sour day.
concept: Building an entire situational comedy around a trivial object.
directorNote: It's an exercise in situational comedy, proving that you don't need an epic premise to make people laugh uncontrollably.
inspiration: The trivial things that cause massive arguments in everyday life.
challenges: Keeping the momentum of the joke going without it feeling repetitive.

title: Bachelor Quarantine
synopsis: Produced during the height of the global pandemic, this special episode throws the beloved characters of Bachelor Point into lockdown, capturing the frustration, paranoia, and humor of isolation.
logline: They couldn't survive each other before, now they can't leave.
concept: A timely, relatable reflection on the struggles of lockdown.
directorNote: We needed to give people something to smile about during a very dark time.
inspiration: The universal experience of the 2020 COVID-19 lockdowns.
challenges: Filming safely under strict lockdown conditions with a limited crew.

successStats.viewership: Millions of views, highly appreciated for its timing
successStats.culturalImpact: Brought immense relief and laughter during the pandemic

title: Muthophone
synopsis: A deeply emotional story centered around communication, missed opportunities, and how modern technology bridges and breaks human connections.
logline: A single call can change a life.
concept: Exploring the emotional weight of phone calls in modern relationships.
directorNote: In an era of instant messaging, the sound of a voice still holds the most power.
inspiration: The reliance on digital communication in intimate relationships.
challenges: Relying heavily on voice acting and solitary acting performances.

title: How Sweet
synopsis: A lighthearted romantic comedy that brings together two contrasting individuals in a sweet, funny, and unforgettable journey.
logline: Sometimes love is just a little too sweet.
concept: A feel-good romantic story designed for a premium OTT viewing experience.
directorNote: A project purely designed to make the audience feel good.
inspiration: Classic romantic comedy tropes given a fresh, modern Bangladeshi spin.
challenges: Maintaining a light, breezy tone without becoming cliché.

title: The End
synopsis: A dramatic exploration of closure, focusing on the final moments of a relationship and the bittersweet reality of saying goodbye.
concept: To focus entirely on the emotional climax of a relationship's end.
directorNote: Endings are never easy, but they are necessary for new beginnings.
inspiration: The painful necessity of closure in human relationships.
challenges: Sustaining a heavy emotional tone throughout the runtime.

title: Only Me
synopsis: A humorous take on digital privacy, social media obsession, and romance in the age of Facebook privacy settings.
logline: When your relationship status is complicated.
concept: A satire on how social media dictates modern romance.
directorNote: We live our lives for an audience of online friends rather than for ourselves.
inspiration: The absurdities of social media behavior.
challenges: Visually representing digital interactions in a compelling way.

title: Viral Girl
synopsis: A powerful commentary on cyberbullying, internet culture, and the devastating psychological impact of becoming an unwilling internet sensation overnight.
logline: Fame is a nightmare when you didn't ask for it.
concept: To expose the dark side of viral internet culture in Bangladesh.
directorNote: The internet gives everyone a voice, but it also gives everyone a stone to throw.
inspiration: Real-life incidents of individuals whose lives were ruined by unsolicited viral videos.
challenges: Handling a highly sensitive topic with the nuance it deserved.

successStats.culturalImpact: Highly praised for its strong social message and lead performance.
